title: Adjacent logistics and procurement master data
summary: Credit, units, classification, batches, serial identity, product structure, configuration and source-of-supply data owned beyond core Sales but consumed across logistics.

entities.title: Credit Master Data
entities.memory_hook: The sales order sees a customer; credit management sees a risk account inside a credit segment.
entities.business_question: Which credit account, segment, limit, risk class and check policy context should evaluate this exposure?
entities.scope: SAP Credit Management uses Business Partner credit roles/profile/segment data. It is adjacent to SD customer master but directly controls whether sales documents can proceed.

high_value_attributes.name: BP role UKM000
high_value_attributes.why: Makes credit-management data available for the business partner.

high_value_attributes.name: credit limit and validity
high_value_attributes.why: Defines segment-level exposure capacity.

high_value_attributes.name: risk class
high_value_attributes.why: Can drive check-rule/risk policy.

high_value_attributes.name: check rule
high_value_attributes.why: Controls which credit checks apply.

precedence: Free credit limit alone does not prove a pass; the check rule may contain other checks and the credit account can differ from the sold-to party.

modern: Maintain Business Partner / credit management apps
maintenance.note: Keep SD trigger/config separate from credit master/risk data.

failure_signals: order blocked with apparently free limit
wrong credit segment
unexpected credit account/payer
limit expired
manual release used to hide master-data issue
lead_questions: Which credit account and segment were actually checked?
Which check rule ran?
Is the issue exposure lifecycle, master data, or SD trigger configuration?

relations.why: credit data is maintained for a business partner/credit account
credit mechanism consumes profile/segment/risk data

entities.title: Units of Measure and Quantity Constraints
entities.memory_hook: A quantity without its unit is just a number waiting to become an incident.
entities.business_question: In which unit is the product sold, converted, rounded, delivered, and priced?
entities.scope: Product master unit-of-measure and sales quantity data are consumed across order entry, pricing, ATP, delivery, and interfaces.

high_value_attributes.name: base and alternative units / conversion
high_value_attributes.why: Foundation for quantity translation.

high_value_attributes.name: sales unit
high_value_attributes.why: Default sales-document unit.

high_value_attributes.name: minimum order quantity
high_value_attributes.why: Commercial constraint.

high_value_attributes.name: delivery unit / minimum delivery quantity
high_value_attributes.why: Fulfillment quantity constraint.

high_value_attributes.name: rounding profile
high_value_attributes.why: Can adjust order-proposal quantities.

precedence: The document may allow a different sales unit depending on product settings; interfaces must not assume base UoM equals sales UoM.

maintenance.note: Owned in product master, separated here because its cross-process blast radius deserves its own graph node.

failure_signals: price appears wrong only for one unit
quantity multiplied/divided incorrectly in interface
delivery unit violation
ATP appears inconsistent because compared quantities use different units
lead_questions: What is the base unit versus sales unit?
Which conversion factor was used?
Does the condition record price per the same unit?

relations.why: unit data belongs to product master
price conditions can depend on unit
availability/confirmation quantities require consistent units

entities.title: Batch Master
entities.memory_hook: Sales promises a product; delivery may need to prove which exact lot satisfied the promise.
entities.business_question: Which batch is eligible, available, and preferred for this delivery context?
entities.scope: Batch master data is not Sales-owned, but Sales, delivery and warehouse execution can consume batch-managed-product settings, batch status and classification through batch determination.

high_value_attributes.name: batch-management requirement
high_value_attributes.why: Makes exact-lot handling part of execution.

high_value_attributes.name: batch characteristics/classification
high_value_attributes.why: Selection criteria can use business/quality attributes.

high_value_attributes.name: batch status/availability
high_value_attributes.why: A technically matching batch may still be unusable.

precedence: Product master activates batch relevance; determination configuration and strategy choose among eligible batch master data.

modern: batch management apps depending on deployment
maintenance.note: Warehouse execution may own the final selection depending on architecture.

failure_signals: no batch found despite stock
wrong batch characteristic selected
manual batch always required
delivery fails after sales order looked valid
lead_questions: Is this a product-master relevance issue, a batch-master eligibility issue, or a search-strategy issue?
Where is batch determination executed in this architecture?

relations.why: batches belong to batch-managed products
eligible batch master/classification data feed batch determination
batch characteristics are maintained through the classification framework

entities.title: Sales BOM / Product Structure
entities.memory_hook: One commercial item can explode into many operational items.
entities.business_question: When a structured product is sold, which components become sales subitems and where does pricing/quantity control live?
entities.scope: Bills of material are cross-application master data. Sales BOM processing can expose header/component structures whose behavior is then governed by item-category and pricing setup.

high_value_attributes.name: header/component relation
high_value_attributes.why: Defines the product structure.

high_value_attributes.name: component quantity
high_value_attributes.why: Controls explosion quantities.

high_value_attributes.name: item category in BOM/component context
high_value_attributes.why: Influences how components are interpreted downstream.

consumed_by: delivery/ATP for components depending on process
precedence: BOM master data defines structure; Sales item-category design decides whether header or components carry commercial/logistics behavior.

modern: Manage Bills of Material / deployment-specific apps
maintenance.note: Exact sales behavior depends on product/item-category configuration, not BOM structure alone.

failure_signals: BOM does not explode
wrong component quantity
price sits at wrong level
delivery relevant level differs from expectation
lead_questions: Is the issue BOM structure or Sales item-category control?
Which level owns pricing and delivery?
Is the BOM valid for the relevant context/date?

relations.why: header and components are products/materials
subitem/higher-level context participates in item-category determination

entities.title: Variant Configuration Context
entities.memory_hook: A configurable material is not one product with many descriptions; it is a product whose chosen characteristics become process data.
entities.business_question: Which characteristics, allowed values, dependencies, and configuration result define the exact sellable variant?
entities.scope: Variant configuration data is broader than SD master data but becomes decisive for configurable sales items, BOM/routing selection, pricing, procurement and production. It can reuse classification characteristics and classes while adding configuration profiles and dependency logic.

high_value_attributes.name: characteristics and value domains
high_value_attributes.why: Define what can be configured.

high_value_attributes.name: dependencies/constraints
high_value_attributes.why: Prevent invalid combinations and derive values.

high_value_attributes.name: configuration profile/model linkage
high_value_attributes.why: Connects the product to configuration behavior.

high_value_attributes.name: pricing-relevant characteristics
high_value_attributes.why: Can feed variant-condition pricing designs.

precedence: Separate product master, configuration model, chosen runtime configuration, and downstream production data; calling all of it 'material master' destroys the diagnostic path.

modern: Advanced Variant Configuration / classification tools depending on deployment
classic: CU41/CU42/CU43 and classification transactions are classic orientation
maintenance.note: AVC versus classic LO-VC boundaries are release/deployment topics and should remain explicit.

failure_signals: invalid combination accepted/rejected
wrong BOM selected
variant surcharge missing
configuration lost during copy/returns
lead_questions: Are we debugging master model data or the runtime configuration instance?
Is this AVC or classic LO-VC?
Which downstream object consumes the characteristic value?

relations.why: configuration model is attached to a configurable product
configuration can affect pricing
configured requirements can affect fulfillment/availability context
variant configuration can reuse classification characteristics and classes

entities.title: Classification
entities.memory_hook: Classification turns reusable attributes into a shared search and selection language across logistics.
entities.business_question: Which structured characteristics describe this object, which class and class type own them, and which process consumes the values?
entities.scope: SAP Classification (CA-CL) is a cross-application framework for characteristics, classes, object assignments and characteristic values. Materials, batches, documents, technical objects and other supported objects can use it. Logistics processes consume classification only when their search, selection or configuration logic is designed to read the values.

high_value_attributes.name: characteristic definition
high_value_attributes.why: Controls data type, unit, allowed values, intervals and other value rules.

high_value_attributes.name: class and class type
high_value_attributes.why: Groups characteristics and connects the model to an object category or special business function.

high_value_attributes.name: class hierarchy
high_value_attributes.why: Can create structured search paths and inherited characteristics where the class type supports them.

high_value_attributes.name: object assignment
high_value_attributes.why: Connects the concrete material, batch, document or technical object to the reusable class.

high_value_attributes.name: characteristic valuation
high_value_attributes.why: Provides the structured facts that object search and downstream selection logic can consume.

precedence: Characteristics and classes define the reusable model; the classified object carries the actual valuation.
Classification describes the object. A search strategy, batch strategy, release procedure, configuration model or integration still owns the runtime decision.
Classification and Variant Configuration are different layers even though Variant Configuration reuses classification concepts.

modern: classification and object-specific maintenance apps depending on deployment
maintenance.note: Classic GUI transactions and some class-type examples are especially relevant to SAP S/4HANA on-premise/private-edition landscapes. Confirm the deployment before prescribing a maintenance path.

failure_signals: object cannot be found by expected characteristic values
wrong or missing class assignment
characteristic value is missing or outside the allowed domain
batch determination misses stock because classification criteria do not match
classification-based purchasing release strategy is not found
Variant Configuration behavior is blamed on ordinary classification data without checking the configuration model
integration maps a display text instead of a stable characteristic/value key
lead_questions: Which object and class type are actually used at runtime?
Is the problem in the characteristic definition, class structure, object assignment, valuation, or downstream selection logic?
Which runtime mechanism reads this characteristic?
Are we debugging Classification data or Variant Configuration behavior?

relations.why: materials and products are common classification objects
batch classification provides values used by batch-selection scenarios
Variant Configuration reuses classes and characteristics but adds configuration-specific rules

entities.title: Serial Number
entities.memory_hook: A batch identifies a lot; a serial number identifies one exact physical unit.
entities.business_question: Which individual unit moved, where is it now, and which document proves that movement?
entities.scope: Serial-number management adds individual identity below the material level. The material master serial-number profile controls where serial numbers are required or allowed, while runtime documents record the concrete serial assignments.

high_value_attributes.name: serial number profile
high_value_attributes.why: Controls when serial-number procedures apply to the material.

high_value_attributes.name: material + serial identity
high_value_attributes.why: Distinguishes one physical unit from another.

high_value_attributes.name: system and user status
high_value_attributes.why: Shows whether the unit can participate in relevant business steps.

high_value_attributes.name: stock/location context
high_value_attributes.why: Supports unit-level traceability.

high_value_attributes.name: equipment link
high_value_attributes.why: Extends the identity into maintenance/service scenarios when equipment is created or linked.

precedence: The product/material master controls serial-number relevance through the serial-number profile.
The serial master identifies the unit; the business document proves where that serial number was used in a concrete transaction.
Equipment adds technical-object lifecycle data and should not be confused with the serial number itself.

modern: Serial-number and material apps depending on deployment
maintenance.note: The exact creation point can be manual or process-driven. Do not assume every serial number is created before the logistics document.

failure_signals: delivery requires serial numbers unexpectedly
goods movement rejects a serial assignment
same physical unit appears under the wrong material context
traceability stops at batch level when unit-level proof is required
lead_questions: Which serial-number profile is active for the material?
At which process step should the serial number be entered or created?
Is the defect master identity, document assignment, status, or equipment linkage?

relations.why: serial-number procedures are controlled from the material/product context
delivery execution can require and validate concrete serial assignments

entities.title: Business Partner / Supplier
entities.memory_hook: The Business Partner is the identity; the supplier roles and purchasing data define how that party supplies us.
entities.business_question: Who supplies the material or service, and under which company-code and purchasing-organization rules?
entities.scope: In SAP S/4HANA, supplier master data is maintained through Business Partner integration. General identity is shared, while supplier company-code and purchasing-organization views carry procurement-specific data.
key_dimensions: plant or supplier subrange where used

high_value_attributes.name: supplier purchasing organization data
high_value_attributes.why: Controls purchasing-specific defaults and responsibilities.

high_value_attributes.name: order currency and Incoterms
high_value_attributes.why: Provide commercial defaults for procurement.

high_value_attributes.name: payment terms
high_value_attributes.why: Connect purchasing and invoice/payment context.

high_value_attributes.name: partner functions
high_value_attributes.why: Allow ordering address, goods supplier and invoicing party responsibilities to differ.

precedence: General BP identity, company-code data and purchasing-organization data have different scopes.
A Purchasing Info Record can add more specific supplier × material data without replacing the supplier master.

modern: Manage Supplier Master Data depending on deployment
maintenance.note: Use BP roles and purchasing views in S/4HANA; classic vendor tables remain useful technical orientation in many private-cloud/on-premise systems.

failure_signals: supplier exists but cannot be used by the purchasing organization
wrong ordering or invoicing partner
unexpected payment or Incoterms default
source determination finds data for another supplier context
lead_questions: Is the issue general BP identity, company-code data, or purchasing-organization data?
Which supplier role and purchasing organization are active?
Is a more specific supplier-material record overriding the generic default?

relations.why: supplier is another Business Partner role and business context
purchasing info records specialize the supplier-material relationship

entities.title: Purchasing Info Record
entities.memory_hook: The supplier says who can supply; the Purchasing Info Record says how this supplier supplies this material.
entities.business_question: Under which purchasing-organization and plant context can this supplier provide this material, with which commercial and delivery data?
entities.scope: A Purchasing Info Record stores reusable supplier-material purchasing data. It is more specific than either the supplier or material alone and can contain purchasing conditions, delivery data and quantity defaults.

high_value_attributes.name: purchasing conditions and price
high_value_attributes.why: Provide reusable commercial data for purchasing.

high_value_attributes.name: planned delivery time
high_value_attributes.why: Influences procurement lead-time expectations.

high_value_attributes.name: order unit and conversion
high_value_attributes.why: Controls how the supplier-material relationship is ordered.

high_value_attributes.name: quantity and delivery tolerances
high_value_attributes.why: Define acceptable procurement variation.

high_value_attributes.name: confirmation / invoice-related indicators where maintained
high_value_attributes.why: Can shape downstream execution and invoice handling.

precedence: Treat the info record as supplier × material specificity, not as a duplicate supplier or material master.
Source List, Quota Arrangement and outline agreements can change which source is selected; the info record mainly describes the reusable relationship.

maintenance.note: Available fields and apps vary by deployment and procurement scenario.

failure_signals: source exists but PO defaults are wrong
planned delivery time differs by supplier for the same material
purchasing price is missing only for one supplier-material pair
wrong order unit or tolerance appears in purchasing
lead_questions: Is the defect generic supplier data, generic material data, or the supplier-material relationship?
Which purchasing organization and plant are in scope?
Is the system using an info record, outline agreement, or another source?

relations.why: supplier side of the purchasing relationship
material/product side of the purchasing relationship

entities.title: Source List
entities.memory_hook: The Source List answers which sources are valid, fixed, or blocked for this material and plant during this period.
entities.business_question: Which source of supply is allowed, blocked, or fixed for this material and plant on the requirement date?
entities.scope: Source List records control valid sources of supply by material, plant and validity. A record can reference a supplier, supplying plant, purchasing info record or outline-agreement context, depending on the scenario.

high_value_attributes.name: validity period
high_value_attributes.why: Makes source eligibility time-dependent.

high_value_attributes.name: fixed source indicator
high_value_attributes.why: Can make one source the preferred/fixed assignment.

high_value_attributes.name: blocked source indicator
high_value_attributes.why: Explicitly prevents a source from being selected.

high_value_attributes.name: MRP sourcing control
high_value_attributes.why: Controls whether the source list participates in planning/source assignment.

high_value_attributes.name: supplier / supplying plant / outline agreement reference
high_value_attributes.why: Identifies the concrete source context.

precedence: A valid source list record does not replace Supplier or Purchasing Info Record data; it controls source eligibility.
Quota Arrangement answers a different question: how requirements should be allocated among sources. Outline agreements are procurement documents, not another master-data object.

modern: Manage Source Lists / released APIs depending on deployment
maintenance.note: Use validity dates and source type together; a technically existing supplier is not automatically a valid source.

failure_signals: MRP cannot assign a supplier although one exists
unexpected supplier becomes fixed
valid source is blocked by date or source-list flag
source determination differs between plants
lead_questions: Is a source list required for this material/plant?
Which record is valid on the requirement date?
Is the source fixed, blocked, or only one candidate among several?

relations.why: source lists are maintained for material/plant context
external source-list records can identify suppliers
source assignment can be linked to purchasing-info-record context

entities.title: Quota Arrangement
entities.memory_hook: Source List says which sources may be used; Quota Arrangement controls how demand is allocated across eligible sources.
entities.business_question: How should requirements for this material and plant be distributed among available sources over the validity period?
entities.scope: Quota Arrangement is a reusable sourcing-control object for material/plant requirements. SAP documentation also describes it as a purchasing document. In this catalogue it stays in the adjacent sourcing layer rather than being presented as customer/material-style business master data.

high_value_attributes.name: quota
high_value_attributes.why: Defines the relative share assigned to a source.

high_value_attributes.name: allocated quantity
high_value_attributes.why: Feeds quota rating and reflects how much a source has already received.

high_value_attributes.name: base quantity
high_value_attributes.why: Can influence initial quota calculation.

high_value_attributes.name: minimum quantity for split quota
high_value_attributes.why: Controls when splitting logic can apply in supported scenarios.

high_value_attributes.name: source type
high_value_attributes.why: Allows external procurement, supplying plant or other supported source contexts.

precedence: Quota Arrangement does not make an invalid source valid; source eligibility and the detailed source data still need to be correct.
A quota normally allocates requirements across sources over time; it should not be explained as simply splitting every individual requisition line.

maintenance.note: Check quota-arrangement usage and the target sourcing process before expecting the quota to affect MRP or requisitions.

failure_signals: requirements concentrate on one supplier unexpectedly
quota percentages look correct but source assignment does not follow them
allocation differs after historical quantities change
quota exists but is outside the validity period or not active for the intended process
lead_questions: Is the quota arrangement valid for the requirement date and plant?
Which applications are configured to use it?
What are the current allocated quantities and quota ratings?

relations.why: quota arrangements are maintained for material/plant demand
external quota items can allocate demand to suppliers
source eligibility and quota allocation are complementary sourcing controls
